name: kabinku-reel
description: Frame-accurate motion-graphics source for the KabinKu 27s promo reel (HTML timeline rendered with Playwright, encoded with ffmpeg).

scripts.music: python3 music.py music_raw.wav && ffmpeg -y -i music_raw.wav -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=9 -ar 48000 music.wav
scripts.encode: ffmpeg -y -framerate 30 -i frames/%05d.jpg -i music.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 22 -maxrate 6M -bufsize 12M -pix_fmt yuv420p -profile:v high -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart -shortest ../deliverables/KabinKu_Reel_9x16.mp4
scripts.feed: ffmpeg -y -i ../deliverables/KabinKu_Reel_9x16.mp4 -vf crop=1080:1350:0:260 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 22 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a copy -movflags +faststart ../deliverables/KabinKu_Feed_4x5.mp4
